graph.name: MakeMyTrip Next-Gen SOC with Apache Metron and Serverless Security Data Lake
graph.notes: MakeMyTrip built a next-gen SOC from the ground up: hybrid data ingest (AWS and on-prem) into Apache Metron for parsing, enrichment and profiling; a serverless security data lake (EMR, S3, Athena) for long-term telemetry with a feedback loop into Metron; and a SOAR platform (Blitz, open source) for semi-automated incident response, e.g. via WAF. Scale: about 20 data sources, about 5000 events per second, about 250 million events indexed per day.

nodes.name: On-Prem
nodes.notes: On-premise data sources; standard syslog or Kafka integration pulls events directly into Apache Metron.

nodes.name: S3 (telemetry source)
nodes.notes: AWS public cloud telemetry source; events are pulled into Apache Metron via Apache NiFi workflows.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: AWS public cloud telemetry source; events are pulled into Apache Metron via Apache NiFi workflows.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: AWS public cloud telemetry source; events are pulled into Apache Metron via Apache NiFi workflows.

nodes.name: CloudTrail
nodes.notes: AWS public cloud telemetry source; CloudTrail log messages are parsed into JSON by Apache Metron.

nodes.name: GuardDuty
nodes.notes: AWS public cloud telemetry source; GuardDuty log messages are parsed into JSON by Apache Metron.

nodes.name: Apache Metron
nodes.notes: Heart of the next-gen SOC. Parses telemetry into JSON, enriches events with contextual intelligence (geolocation, AS number, server role such as flight/hotel/payment), does stream profiling over limited time windows, and detects abnormal behaviour (e.g. producer-consumer ratio deviation). About 20 data sources, about 5000 events per second. Persists data in HDFS.

nodes.name: EMR
nodes.notes: EMR job picks up persistent data from Apache Metron's HDFS and transforms it into S3. Part of the security data lake.

nodes.name: S3 (Security Data Lake)
nodes.notes: Serverless security data lake storage holding telemetry for months to years; about 250 million events indexed per day.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: SQL queries and analytics over S3 for log mining, analytics, forensics and threat hunting; builds long-term models/profiles that are fed back to Apache Metron.

nodes.name: SOAR (Blitz)
nodes.notes: Security orchestration and response platform called Blitz (open source on GitHub). Takes alerts from Metron, adds further context (reverse DNS, whois lookup), presents them in a single pane of glass (mobile, Jira integration) and integrates with WAF, firewalls and internal routers for response.

nodes.name: SOC Analyst (Alerts)
nodes.notes: SOC analyst receives enriched alerts on a mobile handset or via Jira and responds at the click of a button, e.g. blocking a source.

nodes.name: WAF
nodes.notes: Response integration target; settings are modified to mitigate threats, e.g. blocking a source.
